Yes that matches — JLC Reverso Classic Large Small Seconds, ref. Q3858520.

Wait, but the subdial in the photo shows "60, 15, 30, 45" with small seconds hands. The Reverso Classic Large Small Seconds has this.

The Reverso Classic Medium Small Seconds ref. 2438522 has a similar look but the dial center guilloché... Hmm both similar. The Large is 45.6 x 27.4 mm; Medium 40 x 24 mm (or 42.9 x 25.5). In the photo, the watch fills an adult wrist substantially — looks like the large. The strap is dark brown/black alligator leather.

I'll go with reference Q3858520 for Reverso Classic Large Small Seconds in steel. Movement: manual (JLC calibre 822/2). Case material stainless steel. Bracelet leather.

Hmm, but the reference number format — JLC official format uses "Q3858520" or "3858520". I'll write "Q3858520".
